additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata associated with the operation. It typically contains progress information and common metadata such as create time. Some services might not provide such metadata. Any method that returns a long-running operation should document the metadata type, if any.

Operation.description: This resource represents a long-running operation that is the result of a network API call.

CustomerProfileProduct.description: Product information for the customer profile.

product.description: Required. The name of the product.

brand.description: Required. The brand of the product.

citationIds.description: Optional. The citation ids for the product.

VulnerabilityMatch.description: Contains details about a vulnerability match.

technologies.description: Required. All technologies affected by the vulnerability. Ex: "Apache Struts".

description.description: Required. A description of the vulnerability.

matchedTechnologies.description: Optional. The specific technologies from the configured watchlist that triggered the match. Ex: "Apache Struts".

exploitationState.description: Required. The exploitation state of the vulnerability.

cveId.description: Required. The CVE ID of the vulnerability. Ex: "CVE-2025-9876". See https://www.cve.org/ for more information.

exploitationVectors.description: Optional. List of exploitation vectors for the vulnerability.

exploitationConsequences.description: Optional. List of exploitation consequences for the vulnerability.

priority.description: Optional. The priority level of the vulnerability data. Ex: "P1".

epssScore.description: Optional. The EPSS score, representing the probability of exploitation. Example: 0.87.

associations.description: Optional. Associated threat actors, malware, etc. This is embedded as a snapshot because the details of the association at the time of the vulnerability match are important for context and reporting.

disclosureTime.description: Optional. The disclosure time of the vulnerability.

riskRating.description: Required. The risk rating of the vulnerability.
enumDescriptions: Unspecified risk rating. This is the default value when the risk rating is not set.
The vulnerability has been assessed, but a specific risk rating could not be determined or assigned.

collectionId.description: Required. The collection ID of the vulnerability. Ex: "vulnerability--cve-2025-9876".

productFixes.description: Optional. List of product fixes for the vulnerability.

cvss3Score.description: Required. The CVSS score of the vulnerability. Evaluates to CVSS v3 when available with a fallback to v2 and v4. Example: 6.4.

publiclyAvailableExploit.description: Output only. Whether a publicly available exploit exists.

domain.description: Required. The domain name to match against.

state.description: Output only. The verification state of the domain.
enumDescriptions: Default value. This value is unused.
Verification is pending. The customer needs to add the TXT record.

domainMonitoringConfig.description: Optional. If not present, Domain Monitoring is enabled.

DomainSetting.description: Feature settings and toggles for a single specific domain.

DomainMonitoringGtiDetails.description: The GTI details of the domain.

threatClassification.description: Optional. The threat classification of the domain, obtained from the domain report (e.g. DomainMonitoring).

avDetections.description: Optional. Detection counts across vendor feeds.

gtiDomainUri.description: Optional. The GTI link for the domain.

gtiScore.description: Optional. The GTI score of the domain. The threat score is a number between 0 and 100.

enumDescriptions: Default value. The verdict is not set or unspecified.
Verdict is clean; the entity is considered harmless.
Verdict is undetected; no immediate evidence of malicious intent.
Verdict is suspicious; possible malicious activity detected.
Verdict is malicious; high confidence that the entity poses a threat.
Verdict is not applicable; not able to generate a verdict for this entity.
verdict.description: Output only. The verdict of the domain.

domainPermutation.description: Optional. The permutation technique used for the domain (e.g., dictionary, homoglyph).

configurations.description: Optional. Configuration names that are bound to this finding.

severityAnalysis.description: Output only. High-Precision Severity Analysis verdict for the finding.

alert.description: Optional. Name of the alert that this finding is bound to.

name.description: Identifier. Server generated name for the finding (leave clear during creation). Format: projects/{project}/findings/{finding}

detail.description: Required. Holder of the domain specific details of the finding.

severity.description: Optional. Deprecated: Use the `severity_analysis` field instead. Base severity score from the finding source.

relevanceAnalysis.description: Output only. High-Precision Relevance Analysis verdict for the finding.

displayName.description: Required. A short descriptive title for the finding <= 250 chars. EX: "Actor 'baddy' offering $1000 for credentials of 'goodguy'".

provider.description: Required. Logical source of this finding (name of the sub-engine).

audit.description: Output only. Audit data about the finding.

aiSummary.description: Optional. AI summary of the finding.

reoccurrenceTimes.description: Output only. When identical finding (same labels and same details) has re-occurred.

Finding.description: A ‘stateless’ and a point in time event that a check produced a result of interest.

CustomerProfileSecurityConsiderations.description: Security considerations for the customer profile.

considerations.description: Optional. A series of considerations for the security of the organization, such as "high risk of compromise" or "vulnerable to cyberbullying".

note.description: Optional. A note about the security considerations.

CustomerProfileSummary.description: A summarized version of the customer profile. Generated by the backend.

primaryWebsite.description: Optional. The primary website of the customer.

headquarters.description: Optional. The headquarters of the customer.

title.description: Optional. The official name of the customer.

brands.description: Optional. A narrative summary of brands.

parentCompany.description: Optional. The parent company of the customer.

entityType.description: Optional. The entity type of the customer.

founded.description: Optional. The date the customer was founded.

servicesSummary.description: Optional. A narrative summary of services.

areaServed.description: Optional. The area the customer serves.

industry.description: Optional. The industry the customer is in.

productsSummary.description: Optional. A narrative summary of products.

keyPeopleSummary.description: Optional. A narrative summary of key people.

domain.description: Required. The domain name to match against.

DomainMonitoringDomainDetails.description: Details specific to a monitored domain.

SeverityAnalysis.description: Structured severity analysis for a threat.

enumDescriptions: Default value, should never be set.

confidence.description: The level of confidence in the given verdict.
enumDescriptions: Default value. Confidence level is not specified.

reasoning.description: Human-readable explanation from the model, detailing why a particular result is considered to have a certain severity.

channelPath.description: Optional. Channel path (e.g. forum path or sub-channel).

channelName.description: Optional. Name of the communication channel.

channelDescription.description: Optional. Description of the communication channel.

serviceName.description: Optional. Service from the collection event origin (e.g. forum or chat service name).

channelUrl.description: Optional. URL of the communication channel.

CommunicationContext.description: Detailed communication context metadata for documents originating from deep and dark web communication channels.

creatorUserId.description: Output only. User ID who created the monitor.

legacyMonitorId.description: Output only. Unique identifier of the legacy monitor.

emailNotificationImmediate.description: Output only. Deprecated: Whether email notifications are intermediate/immediate. This field will not be used as email notifications are handled through the GTI Mail Hub.

disabledCode.description: Output only. Code indicating why the monitor is disabled (if applicable).

tenantId.description: Output only. ID of the tenant owning the monitor.

conditionVersion.description: Output only. Version of the condition schema.

description.description: Output only. Description of the legacy monitor.

templateId.description: Output only. ID of the template this monitor was created from.

version.description: Output only. Version of the monitor configuration.

staleTime.description: Output only. Time the legacy monitor was considered stale.

displayName.description: Output only. Name of the legacy monitor.

disabledReason.description: Output only. Reason why the monitor is disabled (if applicable).

aggregationSimilarity.description: Output only. Similarity threshold for aggregation.

aggregationEnabled.description: Output only. Whether aggregation is enabled for alerts from this monitor.

updaterUserId.description: Output only. User ID who last updated the monitor.

emailNotificationEnabled.description: Output only. Deprecated: Whether email notifications are enabled. This field will not be used as email notifications are handled through the GTI Mail Hub.

LegacyMetadata.description: Legacy metadata associated with this scenario/monitor.

InsiderThreatFindingDetail.description: A detail object for a InsiderThreat finding.

documentId.description: Optional. Deprecated: Use `discovery_document` instead. The unique identifier of the document that triggered the InsiderThreat finding. This ID can be used to retrieve the content of the document for further analysis.

matchScore.description: Required. Reference to the match score of the InsiderThreat finding. This is a float value greater than 0 and less than or equal to 1 calculated by the matching engine based on the similarity of the document and the user provided configurations.

discoveryDocument.description: Optional. The discovery document associated with the Insider Threat finding.

severity.description: Required. The severity of the InsiderThreat finding. This indicates the potential impact of the threat.
enumDescriptions: Default value, should never be set.

TargetTechnologyAlertDetail.description: Contains details for a technology watchlist alert.

Infrastructure.description: Core infrastructure observations associated with the URL or Domain.

urlResponse.description: Optional. The raw URL response string.

DomainMonitoringFeatureConfig.description: Specific configuration for the Domain Monitoring feature.

disabled.description: Optional. Whether the Domain Monitoring feature is disabled for the domain.
